reasoning: The question asks whether the ICE BofA Corporate Index OAS will increase from Oct 11 to Oct 18, 2026. The evidence shows rising Treasury yields (10-year at ~5.3%, highest in 24 years), bond investors becoming skeptical, and some cooling in consumer credit. Rising Treasury yields often correlate with widening credit spreads due to risk-off sentiment. However, the evidence also mentions credit risk premiums have historically been stable. Weekly spread movements are inherently noisy with roughly 50/50 odds for direction. Given the slightly risk-off environment suggested by rising yields and investor skepticism, I lean slightly toward spreads widening.
